name: pam_faillock
description: Account lockout module for failed login attempts
detailed_description: Account lockout module that prevents brute-force attacks by tracking failed login attempts. Automatically locks accounts after a configurable number of failures for a specified duration. Provides security auditing and can be configured differently for regular users and root.

parameters.unlock_time: Time to keep user locked out (seconds)

notes:
RedHat/Fedora account lockout; Debian uses pam_tally2 or pam_unix
